title: Lamb Shift Higher-Order Corrections

standard_physics_problem.description: QED vacuum fluctuations shift atomic energy levels
qed_interpretation: Virtual particle-antiparticle pairs screen nuclear charge
Electron self-energy from virtual photon emission/absorption
standard_physics_problem.significance: First precision test of QED (Lamb & Retherford 1947)

postulates_used: Lamb shift from spation pressure modification near nucleus
Electron vortex experiences asymmetric pressure environment
Z⁴ scaling from nuclear pressure gradient enhancement
No vacuum fluctuations - real spation pressure effects

step_1_mechanism.title: Spation Pressure Near Nucleus
step_1_mechanism.argument: Near the nucleus, the spation pressure field is modified by the nuclear displacement. The electron vortex experiences this modified field, which shifts its energy levels.
step_1_mechanism.b04_connection: B04 validated basic mechanism for hydrogen 2S-2P

step_2_s_vs_p_difference.title: S-State vs P-State Difference
step_2_s_vs_p_difference.argument: S-states have non-zero probability at the nucleus (penetrating), P-states have zero probability at nucleus (node). S-states sample the modified spation field more, creating the shift.

he_plus.note: Reduced mass and finite nuclear size corrections needed

step_5_muonic_hydrogen.title: Muonic Hydrogen Lamb Shift
step_5_muonic_hydrogen.argument: Muon's ~207× larger mass means smaller Bohr radius, greater nuclear penetration, larger Lamb shift.
step_5_muonic_hydrogen.scaling: Shift enhanced by (mμ/me)³ factor for nuclear penetration
step_5_muonic_hydrogen.proton_radius_connection: Larger shift → more sensitive to proton size
step_5_muonic_hydrogen.sdt_prediction: Consistent with smaller proton radius (0.841 fm)

key_insights: No vacuum fluctuations needed - real pressure field effects
Muonic hydrogen naturally explained by larger nuclear penetration

qed_approach.interpretation: Electron dressed by virtual photon cloud

sdt_approach.calculation: Pressure field gradient effects on vortex
sdt_approach.interpretation: Real pressure field, no virtual particles

distinguishing_features.sdt_mechanism: Spation pressure field modification by nuclear displacement

testable_predictions.isotope_effects: Lamb shift should depend on nuclear structure
testable_predictions.exotic_atoms: Predictions for antiprotonic hydrogen, pionic atoms
